name: channel_pattern_synthesis_user
content: Surface the recurring topics + their timing. JSON only.

variables.name: digest
variables.description: Month-bucketed digest: per month, the top sender domains (with counts) + a sample of subjects. Metadata + locally-derived only; never a raw body.
examples: 2026-05 (42 msgs): senders [insco.com×5, bank.com×8]; subjects [Policy renewal | Statement ready]

metadata.description: User prompt for passive channel pattern synthesis (channel_pattern_synthesis): feeds the month-bucketed digest and asks for the recurring-topic + timing JSON.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial passive pattern-synthesis user prompt.
